title: Inventory and close required feature gaps
description: Compare the prior extension's actual workflows with our needs and classify must-have versus intentionally excluded behavior. Implement required browser/JS fetch, social/X options, provider coverage, research, PDF/YouTube, or repository/content workflows only where the inventory requires them; do not preserve scope assumptions without validation.

logs.msg: Inventory scope: required workflows come from user requests and existing use, not parity with every pi-web-access feature; classify provider, fetch, media, GitHub, UI, storage, and research features before sole cutover.

Created ai/research/required-workflows.md: required core is native/direct search, Gemini/Brave/Exa/Parallel, xAI X, evidence cleanup, direct HTML/Markdown/text/JSON, PDF, YouTube captions, and bounded research. Fan-out, opaque answers, history storage, GitHub/media/browser/remote extraction, caching, and overlapping providers are deferred or Pi/Bash-owned until concrete need.
